get_buy_sell_rates.description: Get what NBP buys and sells a currency at - its table C bid and ask prices, with the spread between them worked out. A different table from the average rates, covering about eleven major currencies, and the one to use when the question is what a conversion actually costs rather than what it is worth on paper. Comes back with the trading date as well as the effective date, because table C quotes the market a day before the prices take effect. No API key required.

get_gold_price.description: Get the price the National Bank of Poland calculates for gold - the official figure, published every working day since 2013. NBP quotes one gram of pure gold in złoty; this step gives that figure and works out the troy ounce and the kilogram beside it, so it can be compared with any other gold price in the world. Ask for it in another currency and it is converted at NBP's own average rate for the same day. No API key required.

Table A is the average rates of the convertible currencies, published every working day; table B is the average rates of the less common ones, published weekly on Wednesdays; table C is the buy and sell prices of about eleven major currencies. Every rate is against the złoty. For a rate between two other currencies, use 'Get an exchange rate'. No API key required.

description: Official exchange rates and gold prices from Narodowy Bank Polski, the central bank of Poland - the figures Polish invoices, VAT returns, customs declarations and audited accounts are settled at. Convert an amount between any two of the roughly 170 currencies NBP quotes, look up a rate for today or for the day an invoice was raised, and take it on the basis Polish tax law asks for: the rate published on the last working day before. Pull a whole table in one step, chart a rate over time, read the buy and sell prices NBP quotes in table C, and follow the official price of gold per gram, ounce or kilogram. Rates go back to 2002 and gold prices to 2013. No account or API key required.
